scenes.title: Only the Neighbour Next Door
scenes.summary: The Tuesday-night knock turns out to be a neighbour returning a misdelivered city envelope confirming Wednesday's three-o'clock visit.

scenes.title: General in an Apron
scenes.summary: At 6:00 AM Wednesday, Mei sits with her ankle on pillows directing Peng's bread kneading and Qing's lemon curd like a cheerful general.

scenes.title: Carrots by the Millimetre
scenes.summary: Hao chops vegetables with architectural precision for the lentil soup while Peng and Mei tease him affectionately.

scenes.title: Setting Room Nine
scenes.summary: At half past two on Wednesday, Qing, Song, and Chen lay white linen cloths, stoneware cups, and small lemon branches on the tables in Room 9.

scenes.title: Put the Speech Away
scenes.summary: At 2:55 PM, Zhou nervously recites a stiff five-page history speech until Qing and Chen convince him to simply welcome the visitor naturally.

scenes.title: The Heritage Stamp
scenes.summary: After inspecting the open gate, sunlit café tables, lending books, and hot tea, the heritage clerk signs the protection form—and asks Song to play.

scenes.title: Toast in the Kitchen
scenes.summary: Listening to Song's piano waltz from the kitchen doorway, Mei, Hao, and Peng clink teacups to celebrate passing the review.

scenes.title: The Tune at the Gate
scenes.summary: At the courtyard gate, Zhou, Qing, and Song learn the passerby was the violinist neighbor who used to play Friday duets with Zhou's aunt thirty years ago—and he promises to return Friday at six!
